records.observation: Historical B0 auxiliary MAE 1.14585 m and 99.4002% above tolerance.
records.hypothesis: Possible wrong focal grid, PLY scale, frame, renderer depth semantics, reference or denominator.
records.impact: Current scientific interpretation of expected splat Z against first-surface depth. No confirmed deployment or training defect.
records.validation: Preregistered family selection and 770 region rows. All 32 acquisition chains, 1,008 Blender projections, native source references and 335 geometry checks.
records.conclusion: Raw discrepancy reproduced. Remaining evidence supports a scene-dependent model, rendering-construct or data-domain limitation. A unique upstream contribution has not been identified.

records.observation: Half-sized R1 source predictions had only original 512-grid geometric reference data.
records.hypothesis: Interpolated camera-Z would mix surfaces and sample the wrong rays.
records.confirmed_cause: Original R1 protocol retained reduced input RGB, source camera and predictions but did not require a native reduced-grid source truth.
records.impact: New diagnostic source comparisons only. Formal target grids remain 512 square.
records.validation: Reopened sealed Blender files, matched actual 256 camera matrices and validated native EXR Position, native PNG and reprojected landmarks.
records.conclusion: Four matched source comparisons are available.

records.observation: The Blender World can illuminate an empty camera ray while splats composite over black.
records.hypothesis: Open backgrounds or incorrect compositing might explain the closed-studio findings.
records.confirmed_cause: Background contracts diverge on an exposed World. The actual studio wall and floor geometrically cover the padded frame.
records.impact: Existing closed studio study supported. Extension to open backgrounds needs an explicit matched contract.
records.validation: Check actual opaque boxes and camera frusta for all 172 grids. Compare closed scene and open World with primary-camera World visibility on and off.
records.conclusion: Every B0 reference pixel hits geometry. The closed control gives zero RGB delta, exposed World changes from lit to black.

records.observation: The initial GPU control wrote sample arrays and then failed to encode its PLY metadata.

records.impact: Probe receipt only. Original scientific renderer, geometry, frozen expectations, tolerances and fitted model are identical.
records.validation: A scalar regression test plus a complete new native GPU run and independent CPU regrade.
records.conclusion: 335 of 335 checks passed on both hosts.

records.validation: Reran with recorder-resolved Python and a named JSON file, checked all declared hashes and thresholds.
records.conclusion: 296 original bundles verified and the successful Mac grade is pinned here.
